title: 1940 personnel: Bill Martin, Torran, Billy Starks and Skins
summary: The brothers list changes after George Hudson leaves, naming Bill Martin, Torran, Jimmy Cantor, Billy Starks, Merle Tarrant and Skins.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So we opened there, and we had Leonard Reed as the

show producer. Nothing out of the ordinary happened. We made several changes in the band. George Hudson left the band. And we got a boy named -- we had acquired -- no, Bill Martin was with us in Cincinnati.
I told you Bill Martin. I said Bill Martin. That's what I said.
Oh, yeah, yeah. We had Bill Martin and we had -- on the trombone we had -- who did we have on trombone?
We had Torran.
Torran.
We had Torran. And we had Jimmy Cantor playing guitar.
Uh-huh.
Bone and Torran.
Torran.
Bill Martin. Bill Martin, Billy Starks--
Billy Starks, fell downstairs.
Fell downstairs -- Bill Martin, Billy Starks, was Merle -- ?
Yeah, Merle. We had Merle Tarrant, yes. Had Merle Tarrant.
Okay, we had --
And the same resection, you and
Jeter and myself
The same reed section. When did we get [Holzman?]
No, we had Skins then.
Skins?
Skins came to work late one night, had been hunting?
That's right.
